commits.summary: Document five Spring Boot property binding and restoration cases
commits.body: Compare scoped system properties, placeholder defaults, empty and wildcard map binding, and escaped properties with pinned implementations and tests. The handoff audit checked five ordered sections and fifteen claims. The changed-file selector found no applicable tests.

commits.summary: Document configuration loading and migration behavior
commits.body: Add cases for bracketed imports, config-tree paths, message bundles, property migration thresholds, and incremental configuration metadata. Check the shipped property names against the PR prose and the incremental exclusions against the Gradle fixtures. The ten-case audit passed.

commits.summary: Document startup ordering, context ownership, and registry lifetime
commits.body: Add five cases for auto-configuration ordering, runner dispatch, keep-alive ownership, resource bundles under distinct class loaders, and Micrometer registry reachability. Verify the predictions against source, context lifecycle regressions, and the reported failure modes.

commits.summary: Document WebFlux codecs, HTTP conversion, and server lifecycle
commits.body: Add public checks for codec customization, string encoding, JSON converter choice, redirect location, and graceful shutdown after restart. Confirm the historical WebFlux range covers all three landed commits and distinguish the Tomcat PR description from the landed default.

commits.summary: Document data source, transaction, and Redis cluster selection
commits.body: Add five cases covering JDBC wrapper precedence, lazy-pool derivation, Hibernate auto-commit, Batch Mongo transaction management and Redis topology refresh. Check the public fixtures, selected pool and transaction identities, and the PR’s live-cluster observations.

commits.summary: Document cache, Compose connection, and Kafka listener behavior
commits.body: Add cases for Caffeine async caches, protocol-specific port lookup, PostgreSQL database names, RabbitMQ virtual hosts, and Kafka listener shutdown. Compare connection details with protocol-level observations and the asynchronous listener lifecycle.
